title: Benchmark Marks 30 Years on the NYSE with Closing Bell Ceremony
summary: Benchmark celebrates 30 years on the NYSE with a Closing Bell ceremony, highlighting its growth and commitment to delivering innovative manufacturing solutions.
body_markdown:
**Photo caption:** *David Moezidis and the Benchmark team celebrate at the New York Stock Exchange on November 2, 2026. Image courtesy of NYSE Group.*


Benchmark celebrated an important milestone this week as President and CEO David Moezidis and members of the company’s senior leadership team rang the Closing Bell at the New York Stock Exchange.


The ceremony recognized Benchmark’s 30th year on the NYSE and celebrated the company’s evolution, its employees, customers, and the partnerships that underpin its success.


Since joining the NYSE in 1997, Benchmark has evolved into a differentiated engineering and manufacturing partner, helping customers develop and manufacture highly complex products across advanced computing and communications, aerospace and defense, medical, industrial, and semiconductor capital equipment markets.


This milestone comes at a time of strong momentum for Benchmark. The company recently reported third-quarter revenue of $811 million, up 19% year over year, and raised its 2026 revenue outlook to more than $3 billion.


Looking forward, Benchmark remains committed to helping customers bring complex products to market with confidence, solving their toughest challenges and delivering reliable, high-quality results.
